text: Task Force Null's room at the Citadel. No windows. On the screen, a photograph of one typed sheet.
"Burn Helena before the Publication. Schedule attached. -- A."
Four officers sit in kit nobody has unpacked. Your leave was meant to run three days. It ran one.
Last night a courier in Helena, Montana, carried this to a records archive. We read it. Then we let it go on. If it had not arrived, he would know.
The traitor we took two days ago kept a one-way ticket to Helena in his go-bag. We have read every courier out of that city since.
The label named the building. Mountain States Records & Retention, a commercial archive on the edge of Helena.
Sorry about the leave. This is why.
HaX. The wall.
One card for every operation against ENTROPY. The short version.
Albion, a grid battery site. Critical Mass got in. Voltage, who led it, disappeared after.
She walks the wall fast, like someone who has rehearsed it.
Quantum Dynamics. David Torres stole for the Recruiter to pay for his wife's treatment. Arrested.
Portland. One team, four sites. Austin was reached in time. Two of ours died at the others.
Nightshade, fifteen years one of ours, sent the threat database to Montana. He's in custody and saying nothing.
The rest are files you can read on the plane.
The last two cards have a photograph each and nothing written under them. HaX stops in front of them.
